title: Explosion
text: Put a Fire Microcore in the shape slot. Immediately spreads carried effects within three blocks of the selected position, without distinguishing allies, enemies or the caster.

Explosion delivers effects; it does not inherently add magic damage or destroy terrain. Elements and modifiers determine the result: ordinary Damage is physical, while Infusion changes it to Instant Damage.

Spell power strengthens carried effects but does not change this three-block radius. A Wide Area Rune increases it to 4.5 blocks. Ground targeting creates a burst at each selected surface, so watch your own position and nearby allies.
